lesson: Do not add to an airline sympathy trade after the confirmation carrier fails its required levels; UAL adds should have stopped once DAL lost $85.80 and failed to reclaim $86.20.
evidence: UAL was accumulated to 480 shares while DAL repeatedly failed the planned confirmation thresholds, and the UAL position finished down 1.70% at the profile snapshot.

lesson: A monitor recommendation of hold must be non-executable unless a separate add signal is present.
evidence: Several UAL journal entries said hold or avoid duplicate entry, yet portfolio_state shows additional buy lots after the initial position.

lesson: When a risk-on thesis has multiple confirmed leaders, prioritize the strongest sector breadth over a weaker sympathy leg.
evidence: AMD, MU, and WDC were identified premarket and then rallied with the semiconductor/storage theme, while the profile concentrated in UAL and ended negative.

lesson: Commodity-linked trades need a live commodity input in the monitor context before the system can size them confidently.
evidence: XOM repeatedly confirmed the equity breakdown, but decisions alternated between sell and watch because WTI below $81 was not consistently available in the live snapshot.
